title: RFC 8428 numeric key mapping
notes: Completed RFC 8428 Section 4.3/Table 1 numeric label mapping in Python/Rust/shared vectors without Zephyr/C. Conflict audit found no live exact-file owner; stale expired SenML claims were preserved. Added Python public bidirectional field/label lookup and exact-int validation, wired production decode through it. Added Rust SenmlLabel enum for all 15 labels (-6..-1,0..8), canonical CBOR key encode/decode, and full-label duplicate tracking in the production decoder while preserving accumulated wire/IPSO work. Added senml_labels.json + dedicated schema + README registration and Python/Rust consumers; literal key bytes are independently derived from canonical CBOR. Green: Python 38 tests, ruff, mypy; dedicated JSON Schema validation; Rust lichen-senml full suite (21 unit + 11 integration), label vectors, fmt, all-target clippy -D warnings, and no-default-features/no_std check.
close_reason: Complete RFC 8428 numeric label registry and cross-language canonical vectors are green
